name: prism-ask
title: Prism Ask
purpose: Decides what the Prism does with words the owner says to it: tell the time, answer from what is held, offer to keep them where they land in time, or look for them in what is held and offer to keep them, and nothing while the Prism is paused.

fields.name: clock
fields.means: whether the words ask the Prism's own clock (the router spec's sentence.now words and phrases)

fields.name: box
fields.means: whether the box the words were said in keeps what is not a question (the Ask) or only asks

fields.name: intent
fields.means: the router's intent reader's answer for the words

fields.name: timed
fields.means: whether the router's time reader found when the words land

fields.name: held
fields.means: whether the owner holds anything unsealed to answer from

meanings.paused: say nothing from what is held: the Prism is paused
meanings.clock: tell the time and date from the Prism's own clock
meanings.empty: say nothing has arrived yet and offer to connect
meanings.answer: answer from what is held, naming what it drew on
meanings.keep: offer to keep the words, saying when they land if they do
meanings.look: answer from what is held as words looked for, and offer to keep them

rules.says: when halted is yes then paused
rules.why: nothing held is said while the Prism is paused

rules.says: when clock is asked then clock
rules.why: what time it is is the Prism's own clock, not anything held

rules.says: when box is asks and held is none then empty
rules.why: a box that only asks, over nothing held, leads to connecting

rules.says: when box is asks then answer
rules.why: a box that only asks answers every prompt as a question

rules.says: when intent is question and held is none then empty
rules.why: a question over nothing held leads to connecting

rules.says: when intent is question then answer
rules.why: a question is answered from what is held

rules.says: when timed is yes then keep
rules.why: words that land in time are something to keep, at that time

rules.says: when held is none then keep
rules.why: with nothing held, what is not a question can only be kept

otherwiseWhy: words that are neither a question nor in time are looked for in what is held, and offered to keep

properties.says: always when halted is yes then paused
properties.why: nothing held is said while the Prism is paused

properties.says: never when intent is question then keep
properties.why: a question is never taken for something to keep

properties.says: never when box is asks then keep
properties.why: a box that only asks never keeps

properties.says: never when box is asks then look
properties.why: a box that only asks never offers to keep

properties.says: never when held is none then answer
properties.why: nothing is answered from what is not held

properties.says: never when held is none then look
properties.why: nothing is looked for in what is not held

properties.says: always when halted is no and clock is not and box is keeps and timed is yes and intent is task then keep
properties.why: a task that lands in time is offered to keep

examples.request: no not keeps question no some
no not keeps question no none
no not keeps task yes some
no not keeps event yes none
no not keeps fact no some
no not keeps fact no none
no not keeps task no some
no asked keeps question no some
yes not keeps question no some
no not asks fact no some
no not asks task yes none
yes asked asks event yes none

limits: It does not read the words; the router's readers (time, intent) and the page's clock words say what they are.
It does not compose the answer's sentences; the router's sentence frames do.
It does not keep anything; keep and look only offer, and the owner keeps by pressing Keep.
